description.text: Duration: May 6 to June 28 (8 weeks) Beginning Time: morning ofMay 6 Suitable Applicants: Beginners with very little Chinese language background. Students whose Chinese level are too advanced for this class can apply to join the regular long-term Chinese program. Curriculum: Language course in the morning and culture courses in the afternoon such as calligraphy, paper cutting, Kung Fu or Chinese painting. Self-paid trips: Self-paid trips to Quanzhou, Zhangzhou, Longyan, Wuyi Mountain can be arranged if there are more than 15 students willing to go. Certificates: OEC will issue Certificates for Completion of Study indicating the study periods. Application Deadline: April 12, please contact us for further solution in case you apply beyond the date. Visa: Please apply X or F visa from the local Chinese Embassy in your country with the admission notice and visa application form (jw202) issued by OEC. If you apply too late or receive no admission notice and jw202 form from us, please contact OEC for permission, and then apply for tourist visa (>30 days). Tuition fees: 5600RMB, including: textbooks, calligraphy tools and tuition. Textbooks are given for free to those who join the program from the beginning.

duration.text: The Eight-week Basic Chinese Class at Xiamen University is a 8 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 777 USD/In total ￥ 5600 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.High school academic transcript 4.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.
